skills.name: goldkey-agent-utilities
skills.description: Evaluate and use GoldKey deterministic agent APIs for JSON canonicalization and validation, prompt-injection signal scanning, URL checks, spend-mandate checks, and Unicode normalization. Use when an OpenClaw or comparable agent needs one of these utilities, needs to compare 0.01-USDC paygo with a 50-USDC 10,000-call access pass, or needs unsigned purchase, renewal, authentication, quota, or delegated-key operations.
